salary_payments.format_description_pain001: ISO 20022, the payment file standard. Usually requires a file transfer agreement with your bank: several online banks do not accept pain.001 through ordinary file upload.
salary_payments.pain001_agreement_warning: pain.001 is normally delivered through a file transfer agreement or a bankgiro connection, not by uploading it in your online bank. Check that your bank accepts the file that way well before the pay date.
salary_payments.sunset_warning: Swedish banks are retiring Bankgirot Lön during 2026 — Swedbank stops accepting LB salary files on 1 August 2026, other banks during the autumn. Switch to pain.001 in good time.

salary_payments.instructions_footer: The amounts are pre-filled — all that remains is signing with BankID in your bank.
salary_payments.open_payments_note: Automatic direct payment via open banking (without file import) is planned.
salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_swedbank: Företagsbetalningar → Importera fil → choose LB format → upload and sign with BankID. Note: Swedbank stops accepting LB salary files after 1 August 2026.
salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_seb: Betalningar → Filöverföring → choose Bankgiro LB → upload and approve.
salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_handelsbanken: Betala → Filimport → choose LB → verify totals → sign. Note: Handelsbanken no longer accepts salary files via Bankgirot.
salary_payments.steps_bg_lb_nordea: Filimport → Bankgiro LB → upload → approve the payment.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_swedbank: Betala och överföra → Filtjänster → Upload file (ISO 20022 pain.001) → sign with BankID.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_seb: SEB Business Arena does not accept pain.001 through file upload, only CSV, and SEB's SEPA CSV covers EUR payments only. pain.001 to SEB requires a file transfer agreement. Without one, choose the Bankgirot LB file instead for domestic salaries in SEK.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_handelsbanken: Betala → Filimport → ISO 20022 → choose pain.001 → sign.
salary_payments.steps_pain001_nordea: Filimport in Nordea Business → Format pain.001 → upload → approve.

settings_booking_templates.line_types_help: The line type controls how the amount is split, not which account is booked. Payment is the line where the money actually moves (e.g. 1930 business account) and takes the full amount. Cost/Revenue is what the purchase or sale is about (e.g. 5410 or 3011). VAT is calculated automatically from the total. To be selectable directly on a bank transaction, the template needs exactly one cost/revenue line and one payment line on opposite sides.

settings_tax_form.vat_taxable_base_over_40m_help: Requires monthly VAT reporting and moves the filing day for both the VAT and employer declarations to the 26th. Deducted tax and employer contributions must still be paid by the 12th. Also select this if Skatteverket has decided that the company files on these dates despite a lower taxable base.
settings_tax_form.vat_has_eu_trade_help: EU purchases or sales affect the yearly VAT deadline.
settings_tax_form.vat_filing_method_label: How is the VAT return filed?
settings_tax_form.vat_filing_method_help: For limited companies with yearly VAT and no EU trade, the date depends on the filing method.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_enabled_help: Applies to VAT-exempt sales of goods or certain services to VAT-registered businesses in other EU countries.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_help: EU goods sales are normally reported monthly (35 ch. 2 § SFL). Services-only sales are reported quarterly by default; quarterly reporting of goods sales requires a decision from Skatteverket.
settings_tax_form.periodisk_filing_method_help: Electronic filing is normally due on the 25th, while paper filing is due on the 20th.
settings_tax_form.tax_contact_help: Used as sender on files to Skatteverket (EU sales list, etc.).
settings_tax_form.fiscal_year_ef_help: Enskild firma must use the calendar year (BFL ch. 3).
settings_tax_form.fiscal_year_change_help: The change affects future fiscal years.
settings_tax_form.pays_salaries_help: Controls the salary module in the menu. Paying out salary requires employer registration with Skatteverket.
settings_tax_form.employer_registered_help: Registered employers must file an employer declaration (AGI) every month, including months without salary payments (nil declaration). Controls AGI deadlines.
settings_tax_form.eu_trade_suggestion_help: There are booked EU sales (accounts 3108, 3308 or 3107) in the last 15 months, but EU trade or the EU sales list is not enabled below. The EU sales list (periodisk sammanställning) must be filed monthly or quarterly when selling to businesses in other EU countries; the late fee is 1,250 kr per report.
settings_tax_form.employer_seasonal_help: Files the employer declaration only for months with salary payments, plus December if no salary was paid during the year.
settings_tax_form.kontrolluppgifter_help: Creates an annual deadline on 31 January for income statements (KU10, KU20, KU31). Covers among other things dividends to owners and interest on owner loans, which are never included in the employer declaration.
settings_tax_form.ku_suggestion_title: Your bookkeeping suggests income statements (KU) are due
settings_tax_form.ku_suggestion_help: There are booked dividends or owner loans (accounts 2898, 2393 or 2893) in the last 15 months. Dividends and interest to owners are reported with a kontrolluppgift by 31 January; they are not part of the employer declaration. The late fee is 500 kr per statement. Enable the reminder below if this applies to your company.
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_label: Remind about the ROT/RUT payout request
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_help: Creates a deadline on 31 January for the ROT/RUT payout request (begäran om utbetalning). The reminder is only created for years with paid ROT/RUT invoices. Missing the date forfeits the Skatteverket payout.
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_suggestion_title: There are invoices with ROT/RUT deductions
settings_tax_form.rot_rut_suggestion_help: The ROT/RUT payout request must reach Skatteverket by 31 January the year after the customer paid (lag 2009:194). Missing the date forfeits the entire payout. Enable the reminder below to have the date tracked automatically.
settings_tax_form.preliminary_tax_monthly_help: Monthly amount per Skatteverket's debited preliminary tax decision. Payment reminders are only created when an amount is set. Leave empty if no preliminary tax is debited.
settings_tax_form.more_deadlines_help: Deadlines that only apply to some companies. Enable the ones that apply to you and the dates are tracked automatically.
settings_tax_form.oss_help: For EU B2C sales above the EUR 10,000 threshold. Due the last day of the month after the quarter; the date does not move for weekends.
settings_tax_form.ioss_help: For distance sales of imported goods (import scheme). Due the last day of the following month; the date does not move for weekends.
settings_tax_form.intrastat_help: SCB's intra-EU trade in goods report, for companies above the thresholds. Due around the tenth working day of the following month. Check SCB's calendar for exact dates.
settings_tax_form.punktskatt_help: For companies liable for excise duties (e.g. alcohol, tobacco, energy). Follows the ordinary tax declaration dates.
settings_tax_form.fyllnadsinbetalning_help: Extra preliminary tax payment to avoid interest on back taxes. Amounts over 30,000 kr by the 12th of the second month after the fiscal year, the rest by the 3rd of the fifth month.
